question: Within a radius of 160 kilometers, where can I locate café on the journey from Strawberry Hill, San Francisco, CA to Sculpture Plaza, Mountain View, CA?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.475512 37.768668)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.078458 37.420875)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.475512 37.768668)',4326)::geography, 160000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-122.475512 37.768668)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
